LOOK: Manila Marathon organizers, MMDA and other partners meet on Tuesday to discuss preparations.
 
This year’s Manila Marathon will utilize a portion of EDSA, a significant step for the country’s premiere running event that will also entail changes in traffic schemes.

The event, featuring 5-km, 10-km, 21-km, and 42-km categories, will take place from 11 p.m. on June 12 (Independence Day) until 8 a.m. the following day. At least 25,570 runners are expected to join. | via @michael_delizo
